result.reason: The insertion substantially reaches the preferred substantive scope: Vendor covers third-party IP, legal-compliance, Vendor-caused data-breach, and gross-negligence/wilful-misconduct claims, while Customer indemnity is confined to Customer content and legal violations. However, it omits the required cooperation obligation from the claims procedure. It also does not actually designate the new remedies as Section 20.5, so Section 9.3's cross-reference remains defective; the parenthetical “(Section 20.5 remedies)” is not an effective section number. The Customer indemnity sentence is also less complete than a fully operative indemnity grant. The changes are otherwise targeted and preserve unrelated terms.
